description: For someone who wants a free time for a manicure, pedicure or nails, brows, a facial or other cosmetology, a haircut or colouring, or a massage in Warsaw. Show free appointment times for one service from the live Norm calendar. Returns times grouped by date and then by master (`days[].masters[].times`) with the same master details as `find_services`, plus the service's add-ons (`addons`: id, name, price, extra minutes) — their ids go to `book_appointment` as `addonIds`. Slots are not held or reserved by this call.

date.description: First date to check, YYYY-MM-DD (Warsaw). Defaults to today.

days.description: How many consecutive days to check from `date`. Default 3, max 7.

name: find_slots
title: Find free appointment slots
